create_pose: create a Pose object with joint quaternions and a root transform Matrix4
create_motion: create a Motion object from joint quaternion arrays and transform arrays with fps
init_humanoid_base_controller: initialize a HumanoidBaseController with a custom motion fps and base offset vector
reset_humanoid_base_controller: reset the HumanoidBaseController joints to rest state with a base transformation matrix
get_pose_vectorized: get the HumanoidBaseController joints and transforms as a flattened list of floats
